QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Performance and Benchmarking_36

question.text: Sahyadri Impact Fund has committed capital of INR 1,000 crore and has called INR 800 crore from LPs. Compute the PIC Multiple.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 7.3.4.1: PIC Multiple = Paid-in Capital / Capital Commitments = 800 / 1000 = 0.80 or 80%. A high PIC means the fund is near end of its drawdown phase — with INR 200 cr dry powder remaining. The Trap: 0.20 is the 'uncalled %'. 1.25 inverts the ratio. 1.00 is the full-commitment case. Note: The workbook's worked example uses these same numbers — INR 800 crore over INR 1000 crore — to illustrate the 0.80 PIC Multiple.
